answer: Each identity claims one slot on the thread, locking a saffron bond at its self-assessed value, at least 80. It pays 5% of that value each epoch as tax. At the summit, anyone may buy any slot at that value, evicting its holder, so low values invite buyout, high values raise tax. The k-th fake costs a saffron bond plus rising tax: the first assesses 80, the 1,000th 120, so 1,000 fakes lock 100,000 credits and pay 5,000 tax per epoch, with no shared bond. A lowball ring fails, as buyers scan the thread for cheap slots. An honest agent holds one slot at 80, pays 4 tax per epoch, and keeps it.
